blind.table_distance_name: hooded monk statue holding a bowl
blind.description: A carved stone statue of a hooded, faceless robed figure holding a wide shallow circular bowl or basin in front with both hands. The drapery of the robes and cowl is smoothly modeled with realistic folds. The entire statue rests on an integrated square stepped stone plinth with a flat bottom.
blind.from_above: Shows the rounded crown and cowl of the hood above the shoulders, with a prominent circular shallow basin extending forward, all framed by the square outline of the base.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 5 ft to 5 ft 3 in tall (slightly shorter than the 5 ft 9 in scale figure), with a base roughly 2.5 ft wide.
